bob_temp.label: Bay of Bengal temperature (t2m add, tcwv +5 %/K)
bob_temp.why: Bay of Bengal marine heatwaves reach about +1 to +3 K; cool anomalies after cyclones are about -1 to -2 K. +3 K is the kit's own warm_ocean shock. 4-5 K are outside the plausible range and tested only to find where the model stops being trustworthy.

as_wind.label: Arabian Sea 10 m wind (u10, v10 percent)
as_wind.why: Monsoon breaks weaken the low-level jet over the Arabian Sea by up to about half; active spells strengthen it by about a third. -40 % is the kit's monsoon_stall shock.

odisha_wet_week.text: coastal Odisha 7-day rain >= 115 mm (observed JJAS 2020 90th percentile of 7-day totals)

central_india_deficit.text: central India 7-day rain at least 50 % below the base forecast

west_coast_heavy.text: west coast heavy-rain share (>= 10 mm/day) up by >= 20 points

central_india_heat.text: central India 7-day mean t2m >= 1 K above the base forecast
